risks.title: Risque de catastrophe naturelle
risks.score_rationale: AIG is exposed to potential losses from natural disasters such as hurricanes and earthquakes. These catastrophic events could have significant impact on insurance operations and financial results. Risks are partially mitigated through reinsurance and catastrophe modeling. Citation: "Risk Factors Regulation 'Our businesses are heavily regulated and changes in laws and regulations may". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Exposure to natural disasters could result in substantial losses affecting operations and financial performance

risks.title: Risque de terrorisme
risks.score_rationale: AIG is exposed to potential losses from terrorist attacks, particularly concentrated in New York City affecting property and workers compensation lines. Risks are mitigated by the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Reauthorization Act (TRIPRA) and private reinsurance protections. Citation: "Terrorism Risk Insurance Act (TRIA), enacted in 2002 to support insurance coverage for certain terrorist". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Terrorism exposure exists but is substantially mitigated through government programs and reinsurance

risks.title: Risque de contrepartie en réassurance
risks.score_rationale: AIG depends on reinsurance to manage insurance risks and capital adequacy. Potential failures of reinsurance counterparties could result in significant unmitigated losses, though this risk is managed through careful selection and monitoring. Citation: "The program was continued under the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Reauthorization Act of 2019 (TRIPRA)". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Reliance on reinsurance partners creates exposure to counterparty credit risk

risks.title: Risque de crédit
risks.score_rationale: AIG is exposed to potential losses from credit defaults of counterparties and investment obligors. Credit quality deterioration could impact financial position. Risk is managed through credit policies and diversification. Citation: "In general, such regulation is for the protection of policyholders rather than the creditors or". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Counterparty and investment credit risks are managed through established credit management processes

risks.title: Risque réglementaire et de conformité
risks.score_rationale: AIG faces potential losses from regulatory changes, particularly regarding capital requirements, reinsurance regulations, and insurance requirements. Changes in regulatory environment could impact operational costs and capital position. Citation: "Noncompliance with such applicable laws, regulations or guidance could have a material adverse effect on". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Regulatory changes could impact operations but AIG maintains active regulatory compliance programs

risks.title: Risque de réputation
risks.score_rationale: AIG is exposed to reputational damage from service failures, claims handling issues, or other operational shortcomings. Reputational harm could impact customer relationships and business performance. Citation: "The Japan Financial Services Agency (JFSA) regulates AIG s operating insurance subsidiaries and insurance holding". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Reputation is managed through quality service delivery and customer-focused operations

company_description: American International Group, Inc. provides insurance products for commercial, institutional, and individual customers in North America and internationally. It operates through three segments: North America Commercial, International Commercial, and Global Personal. The company offers commercial and industrial property insurance, including business interruption and package insurance that cover exposure to made and natural disasters; general liability, environmental, commercial automobile liability, workers' compensation, excess casualty, and crisis management insurance products; risk-sharing and other customized structured programs for large corporate and multinational customers; professional liability insurance; and marine, energy-related property insurance products, aviation, political risk, trade credit, and trade finance products. risks_rationale_fr.0: AIG est exposée à des pertes potentielles dues à des catastrophes (ouragans, séismes). Impact significatif possible sur opérations d'assurance et résultats. Atténué via réassurance et modèles. Citation: "liability could have a material adverse effect on our consolidated financial condition or consolidated res".
risks_rationale_fr.1: AIG exposée aux pertes d'attentats, concentration NYC affectant property et workers compensation. Atténué par TRIPRA et protections réassurance privée. Citation: "likely to have a material adverse effect on our financial position or results of operation".
risks_rationale_fr.2: AIG dépend de la réassurance pour gérer risques et adéquation du capital. Défaillances de contreparties pourraient générer pertes non couvertes, géré par sélection rigoureuse. Citation: "in our business practices, and could result in additional expenses, limitations on certain business act".
risks_rationale_fr.3: AIG exposée aux pertes sur défauts de contreparties et émetteurs. Détérioration de la qualité crédit pourrait impacter la position financière. Gérée via politiques et diversification. Citation: "decreases that could result from the final outcome of the performance goals for the res".
risks_rationale_fr.4: AIG fait face à des pertes potentielles dues aux évolutions réglementaires (capital, réassurance, assurance). Changements pourraient impacter coûts opérationnels et position de capital. Citation: "factors that could cause the attribution to lines of business and accident year to c".
risks_rationale_fr.5: AIG exposée à un risque réputationnel dû aux défaillances de service ou claims. Atteinte à la réputation pourrait impacter les relations clients et la performance commerciale. Citation: "of the company s assets that could have a material effect on the financial statements".

fr.positioning: AIG opère comme un assureur généraliste mondial, couvrant à la fois l'assurance-vie et l'assurance non-vie, avec une forte présence dans l'assurance commerciale. Elle se positionne face à des concurrents tels que Chubb, Travelers et Allianz, en se concentrant sur les grandes entreprises et les marchés internationaux.
fr.tech_products: AIG propose une gamme complète de produits d'assurance, incluant des polices spécialisées pour la responsabilité civile des administrateurs et dirigeants (D&O), l'assurance cyber, ainsi que des solutions de réassurance via sa filiale Chartis. Son portefeuille englobe également l'assurance-vie et les rentes.
fr.moat: Son avantage concurrentiel repose sur une marque mondialement reconnue, une vaste expérience dans la gestion de risques complexes et une large base de clients institutionnels. L'accès à des réseaux de distribution étendus et des capacités de souscription importantes constituent des barrières à l'entrée.
fr.risks: AIG fait face à une concurrence intense dans tous ses segments, et sa rentabilité peut être affectée par des catastrophes naturelles majeures ou des événements systémiques imprévus. La gestion des coûts opérationnels et l'adaptation aux évolutions réglementaires rapides sont des défis constants.

en.positioning: AIG operates as a global general insurer, covering both life and non-life insurance, with a strong focus on commercial insurance. It competes with players like Chubb, Travelers, and Allianz, targeting large corporations and international markets.
en.tech_products: AIG offers a comprehensive suite of insurance products, including specialized Directors and Officers (D&O) liability, cyber insurance, and reinsurance solutions through its Chartis subsidiary. Its portfolio also encompasses life insurance and annuities.
en.moat: Its competitive advantage stems from a globally recognized brand, extensive experience in managing complex risks, and a broad institutional client base. Access to extensive distribution networks and significant underwriting capabilities create barriers to entry.
en.risks: AIG faces intense competition across all segments, and its profitability can be impacted by major natural catastrophes or unforeseen systemic events. Managing operating costs and adapting to rapid regulatory changes remain ongoing challenges.

de.moat: Sein Wettbewerbsvorteil ergibt sich aus einer weltweit anerkannten Marke, umfangreicher Erfahrung im Management komplexer Risiken und einem breiten institutionellen Kundenstamm. Der Zugang zu ausgedehnten Vertriebsnetzen und erheblichen Zeichnungsfähigkeiten bildet Eintrittsbarrieren.
de.risks: AIG steht in allen Segmenten einem intensiven Wettbewerb gegenüber, und seine Rentabilität kann durch größere Naturkatastrophen oder unvorhergesehene systemische Ereignisse beeinträchtigt werden. Die Verwaltung der Betriebskosten und die Anpassung an schnelle regulatorische Änderungen bleiben fortlaufende Herausforderungen.

fr.activity: American International Group assure des risques pour des entreprises et des particuliers à travers le monde.
fr.products: Elle propose des assurances de biens commerciaux, de responsabilité civile, d’assurance automobile et des produits d’assurance voyage.
fr.customers: Ses clients comprennent des entreprises de toutes tailles, des institutions publiques et des particuliers cherchant une protection contre les sinistres.
fr.edge: AIG bénéficie d’une présence internationale et d’une capacité de souscription importante, ce qui lui permet de couvrir des risques complexes et de grande ampleur.

fr.positioning: AIG se situe au cœur de la chaîne de valeur de l’assurance commerciale, offrant des solutions de gestion de risques aux multinationales et aux marchés locaux. Elle opère dans les segments nord-américain, international commercial et personnel global, couvrant ainsi l’ensemble du cycle de vie du client assureur.
fr.tech_products: L’entreprise développe des programmes de partage de risques et des solutions sur mesure pour les grandes entreprises, incluant des produits d’assurance environnementale, de cyber‑risque et de crédit commercial. Son portefeuille comprend également des assurances spécialisées pour l’énergie, l’aviation et le commerce international.
fr.moat: Le principal avantage concurrentiel d’AIG réside dans sa capacité à mobiliser des capitaux importants et à diversifier son portefeuille de risques. Sa marque reconnue, son réseau mondial de courtiers et sa capacité à structurer des solutions complexes créent une barrière à l’entrée pour les nouveaux acteurs.
fr.risks: Le secteur de l’assurance est exposé à la volatilité des sinistres liés aux catastrophes naturelles, ce qui peut affecter la rentabilité d’AIG. La réglementation stricte et les exigences de capital peuvent limiter la flexibilité opérationnelle. Enfin, la concurrence intense des autres assureurs globaux crée une pression sur les marges.

risks.title: Natural Catastrophe Risk
risks.score_rationale: AIG is exposed to potential losses from natural disasters such as hurricanes and earthquakes. These catastrophic events could have significant impact on insurance operations and financial results. Risks are partially mitigated through reinsurance and catastrophe modeling. Citation: "Risk Factors Regulation 'Our businesses are heavily regulated and changes in laws and regulations may". Position: haut Item 1A.

risks.title: Terrorism Risk
risks.score_rationale: AIG is exposed to potential losses from terrorist attacks, particularly concentrated in New York City affecting property and workers compensation lines. Risks are mitigated by the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Reauthorization Act (TRIPRA) and private reinsurance protections. Citation: "Terrorism Risk Insurance Act (TRIA), enacted in 2002 to support insurance coverage for certain terrorist". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.description: Terrorism exposure exists but is substantially mitigated through government programs and reinsurance
risks.summary: Terrorism exposure exists but is substantially mitigated through government programs and reinsurance

risks.title: Reinsurance Counterparty Risk
risks.score_rationale: AIG depends on reinsurance to manage insurance risks and capital adequacy. Potential failures of reinsurance counterparties could result in significant unmitigated losses, though this risk is managed through careful selection and monitoring. Citation: "The program was continued under the Terrorism Risk Insurance Program Reauthorization Act of 2019 (TRIPRA)". Position: milieu Item 1A.
